item.title: Valve amends AI disclosure policy but still stresses players need to be informed if genAI is used
item.description: Valve has amended its guidance on AI disclosure and clarified that while developers using "AI-powered tools" for "efficiency gains" is not the focus of its policy, they must still disclose if generative AI is used in their games. Read more

item.title: Yakuza 3 Remastered will not be available to buy as a standalone game after Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties releases next month
item.description: Yakuza studio Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio has confirmed Yakuza 3 Remastered will no longer be available as a standalone purchase after Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties releases next month. Read more

item.title: Hytale's first update is here - here's what's new
item.description: Hytale's first update is here, introducing a range of fixes and quality-of-life (QoL) improvements as the team promises it is "committed to maintaining a rapidly patching cadence to address issues and improve the game". Read more

item.title: Looks like Resident Evil Requiem isn't getting a collector's edition - but why?
item.description: Earlier this week, Capcom pulled back the (rotting) curtain on the latest instalment of its storied horror series, Resident Evil. And while we learned a bit more about Resident Evil Requiem's story and how it plays out, some fans were surprised that we didn't get a collector's edition (CE) reveal. Read more

item.title: That Pokémon pricing might be eye-watering, but there's never been a better time to love Lego and gaming - in pretty much any price bracket
item.description: It's quite the time to be somebody who loves both video games and Lego. In a sense, it perhaps shouldn't be surprising that the worlds of digital gaming and Danish brick-building toys are colliding so thoroughly - the venn diagram of the audiences of each is frequently simply a circle. In fact, it's sort of surprising that it took this long.
